# museum-open-day-average

museum/service.cjs exports summary(counts). Each array entry is a nonnegative integer visitor count for one open day. For a nonempty array return 'Daily average: <arithmetic mean>', without rounding, using normal JavaScript number-to-string conversion. For an empty array return 'No open days'. Preserve the input. Total visitor counts remain within the safe-integer range; empty input is handled by service.cjs before calling stats.average.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
